protocol.failure: either residual logical-Z parity after final recovery
protocol.final_only: no seed or intermediate correction; one final MWPM
protocol.joint_histogram_encoding: mask = final_only + 2*seed_only + 4*one_step + 8*window_complete; each term is its state-failure Boolean
protocol.noise: independent Bernoulli-p Z faults on 3 L^2 seed-H outputs and 13 L^3 transfer outputs
protocol.one_step: complete seed correction; causal local one-step intermediate correction; one final MWPM
protocol.point_order: sizes outer loop, rates inner loop; both strictly increasing
protocol.point_seed_generation: MersenneTwister(integer base seed); repeated scalar rand(rng,UInt64); discard duplicate values; 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits
protocol.resume: recreate point Xoshiro and sample/discard completed records without decoding; rebuild raw CSV from authoritative checkpoint
protocol.sampler: sample_toric3d_diagonal_z_faults: seed bits first, then participating transfer outputs in schedule order
protocol.seed_only: complete seed correction; no intermediate correction; one final MWPM
protocol.shared_final_decoder: family.prefixes[end], unit-weight data-edge PyMatching MWPM, syndrome-validated recovery
protocol.window_complete: complete seed correction and full local-window recovery; one final MWPM

selection.fit_policy: Same H+6 goodness, crossing, bootstrap, and size/window/model sensitivity guards; diagnostic candidates withheld if any guard fails. Fit only the seven central rates.
selection.rationale: Pilot brackets one-step rise between p=.01 and .04, with p=.02 failure about .3 for L7 andL11. Dense seven-rate grid .0125..0275 targets that crossing; .005,.01,.04 are reference points excluded from primary fit. Same five lattice sizes as X study.
selection.pilot_timing: Observed replay time at L11 p=.02: .0127 seconds per four-arm record, p=.04: .0276; production expected a few minutes, excluding fresh Julia startup.
selection.analysis_note: Numerical model and selection fixed here. Input validation and presentation code may finish during sampling; no adaptation of primary fit window or guards to production outcomes.
